title: Read the due dates
hook: Short job (5 min, due 30) or urgent job (10 min, due 10).

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: that when jobs have deadlines, doing the earliest-due job first can avoid a missed deadline that quickest-first causes

misconception: Doing the quickest job first is always the best order.
objective: Compare deadline misses instead of only completion count.

recall.question: Job A takes 10 minutes and is due at minute 10. Job B takes 3 minutes and is due at minute 30. Which order misses no deadline?
recall.why: A then B finishes A at 10 and B at 13, both on time; B first pushes A to minute 13, past its deadline.
